summary: Independently confirmed all 64 requested estimates. Read the complete main-paper markdown (522 lines), supplementary information (2507 lines), and Reporting Summary (243 lines), including appendices and references. Checked every cited page with PyMuPDF: main PDF pp. 2-8 and Supplement 1 pp. 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 26, 29, 35-41; also checked Supplement 1 pp. 24-25 and Supplement 2 p. 2 for methods and coding. Recovered main Table 1 and Supplementary Tables 1-3 and matched the statistics to the correct study, outcome, rater group, arms and analysis. Checked all 299 source entries and their numeric-field coverage. The supplied scientific-notation, subscript and quotation flags are false positives caused by notation and selected or split table cells. Participant counts, full-model output counts, pooled factorial arms and all requested codes are supported. Experiment 2B correctly records 200 people separately from the 300 human/model outputs; its novelty-category models correctly use rating-level uncertainty because their random intercepts are for judges. Unprinted arm and factorial-cell counts remain null. Supplementary Table 2 components are correctly attributed to lay judges despite its misleading title, as established by the main Methods and Note I. No supplement_changes entry replaces an existing numerical value. Retained main-paper values match the main PDF, including expert creativity P = 0.010 in Experiment 1, P = 0.075 for Experiment 2A versus Human-only, and t = 12.54 in Experiment 2B. The inconsistent supplementary t values were also visually confirmed; their transcription and discrepancy notes are correct. No extraction problems found.
